description: Source code for SAML (Security Assertion Markup Language) integration in Mattermost, including functions for managing SAML certificates, fetching and parsing IdP metadata, and handling SAML tokens.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for SAML configuration and metadata management.

methods.name: GetSamlMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves SAML metadata if SAML is enabled.

methods.name: writeSamlFile
methods.description: Helper to write SAML certificate or key files to platform storage.

methods.name: AddSamlPublicCertificate
methods.description: Adds a public certificate for SAML.

methods.name: AddSamlPrivateCertificate
methods.description: Adds a private key for SAML.

methods.name: AddSamlIdpCertificate
methods.description: Adds an IdP certificate for SAML.

methods.name: removeSamlFile
methods.description: Removes a specified SAML file from platform storage.

methods.name: RemoveSamlPublicCertificate
methods.description: Removes the public certificate used for SAML.

methods.name: RemoveSamlPrivateCertificate
methods.description: Removes the private key used for SAML.

methods.name: RemoveSamlIdpCertificate
methods.description: Removes the IdP certificate used for SAML.

methods.name: GetSamlCertificateStatus
methods.description: Checks the existence of SAML-related certificates and keys.

methods.name: GetSamlMetadataFromIdp
methods.description: Fetches and processes SAML IdP metadata from a URL.

methods.name: FetchSamlMetadataFromIdp
methods.description: Performs HTTP GET to retrieve IdP metadata XML.

methods.name: BuildSamlMetadataObject
methods.description: Parses IdP metadata XML into structured data.

methods.name: SetSamlIdpCertificateFromMetadata
methods.description: Sets IdP certificate from raw metadata bytes.

methods.name: ResetSamlAuthDataToEmail
methods.description: Resets SAML auth data for users to email.

methods.name: CreateSamlRelayToken
methods.description: Creates and stores a new SAML relay token.

methods.name: GetSamlEmailToken
methods.description: Retrieves a SAML email token by token string.
